title: Flow Cytometry-Based Gamma-H2AX Assay for Radiation Biodosimetry
author: Ghazi Alsbeih
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5gzg3x6

steps.title: Collect blood in heparin tubes
steps.instruction: Collect blood samples in heparinized Vacutainers (BD, USA).

steps.title: Irradiate blood aliquot
steps.instruction: Irradiate a 2 mL aliquot of whole blood with the required radiation dose.

steps.title: Incubate irradiated blood
steps.instruction: Incubate the irradiated blood for 30 minutes (or other specified time) at 37 °C.

steps.title: Dilute blood with PBS
steps.instruction: Dilute the 2 mL blood 1:1 by adding 2 mL PBS in a 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Layer on Histopaque
steps.instruction: Carefully layer the diluted blood onto 2 mL Histopaque (Ficoll) in the same tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge for separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1,200 g using an Eppendorf 5810 R for 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect lymphocyte layer and wash
steps.instruction: Isolate the middle cloudy lymphocyte layer and wash 2–3 times with cold PBS (see washing sub‑procedure).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 500 µL cold PBS
Centrifuge at 100 rpm for 10 min (Eppendorf 5810 R)

steps.title: Fix lymphocytes with PFA
steps.instruction: Fix 1–5 × 10⁶ lymphocytes with 2 % paraformaldehyde for 10–20 min on ice; fixed cells may be processed immediately or stored overnight at +4 °C.

steps.title: Wash fixed cells
steps.instruction: Wash fixed lymphocytes twice with PBS (see washing sub‑procedure).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 100 rpm for 10 min (Eppendorf 5810 R)

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate lymphocytes for 1 h at 37 °C with anti‑phospho‑histone H2A.X (Ser139, clone JBW301; Millipore) diluted 1:200 in buffer containing 1 % BSA and 0.12 % Triton X‑100.

steps.title: Wash after primary
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice with PBS (see washing sub‑procedure).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 100 rpm for 10 min (Eppendorf 5810 R)

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate with FITC‑goat anti‑mouse Ig (BD Pharmingen) diluted 1:200 in buffer containing 1 % BSA and 12 % Triton X‑100 for 1 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash after secondary
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice with PBS (see washing sub‑procedure).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 100 rpm for 10 min (Eppendorf 5810 R)

steps.title: Resuspend for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Resuspend lymphocytes in 400–500 µL fresh PBS according to cell concentration.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Measure γ‑H2AX fluorescence on an LSR II flow cytometer (BD) using 488 nm excitation and 533 nm emission; gate a single lymphocyte population, calculate mean fluorescence intensity (MFI), and express yields as the ratio of irradiated to control MFI. Analyze data with BD FACSDiva software.
